name: Select a patient-RNA splicing-variant validation workflow: attributes.setting
description: The setting said Feng et al. 2025 Table 1 is the proxy sequence-classification evidence linked to this use case. The Feng protocols are linked to use-case-splicing-follow-up; the linked foundation-model proxy is Alavi et al. 2026. Change of citation, not of meaning; historical releases retain the previous value.

attributes.previous_value: FRASER, applied to a retrospective Kremer rare-mitochondrial-disorder skin-fibroblast RNA cohort (119 samples/105 individuals, 13 known pathogenic splicing events), recovers a mean 85% (11 of 13) of known events at a reduced 30-sample subsample. A separate, proxy sequence-classification AUC for DNA foundation-model embeddings (Feng et al. 2025, Table 1 Acceptor/Donor) is also linked, scoped as a different endpoint.
attributes.value: FRASER, applied to a retrospective Kremer rare-mitochondrial-disorder skin-fibroblast RNA cohort (119 samples/105 individuals, 13 known pathogenic splicing events), recovers a mean 85% (11 of 13) of known events at a reduced 30-sample subsample. Separate, proxy sequence-classification results for DNA foundation models (Alavi et al. 2026: Evo 2 40B, Genos 10B and NTv3 650M classifying variants with established splicing defects against benign variants) are also linked, scoped as a different endpoint. Feng et al. 2025 Table 1 splice acceptor and donor classification is linked to 'Prioritise variants for splicing experiments', not here.
attributes.source_locator: Store links: use-case-splicing-follow-up assessed_by amp-feng-20261007-protocol-splice-acceptor and -splice-donor, none from this use case; this use case assessed_by rna-splicing-20261011-alavi2026-protocol-opa1-evaluation and -multigene, whose evaluations include the Evo 2 40B, Genos 10B and NTv3 650M configurations

review.method_note: Use case links and the 18 assessed_by judgements read on the PR branch; each judgement's rationale treats proxies as sequence-classification evidence kept separate from patient-RNA recovery, which the new text keeps.
